content:
deploy-bot: Canary halted for release/group/payment-service: chart dependency mismatch detected. required: payments-subchart v2.1, found: v2.0. Health check: 70% passing. Rolling back canary.
Mira Patel: ugh, values merge touched the subchart version. Did the PR bump not include the subchart lock?
Sam Ortiz: looks like this came from #PR-4897. The chart.lock didn't update. I can pin to the v2.0 digest and continue canary if we agree.
Jen Huang: Wait — there's a pending migrations job in the chart v2.1. If we pin to v2.0, migration won't run. That could break prod data model.
Carlos Vega: migration is behind feature flag, but we should be careful. What's the timeline for the change window?
Priya Nair: scheduled change window is Tue 02:00 UTC. We can delay promotion to that window; in the meantime, we can promote a pure-image bump without chart changes.
Mira Patel: proposal: abort the canary for now, pin the release to current stable chart (v2.0), re-run canary image-only. Postpone values/schema merge to change window with DB-approved migration plan.
Sam Ortiz: sounds safe. I can run image-only canary: `helm upgrade --reuse-values --set image.tag=sha256:abcd1234 payment-service ./chart --namespace payments --set canary=true`
Jen Huang: add a release-note entry about the postponed migration and the reason (chart lock mismatch). I'll handle the wording.
Priya Nair: also add a follow-up to ticket ARCH-721 for verifying chart.lock updates in CI.
ops-bot: Created ticket ENG-3098: "Pin release to stable chart + image-only canary" and scheduled manual promotion for 2025-08-05 02:00 UTC. Link: https://tickets.redwood/ENG-3098
Mira Patel: who will ack the hotpatch image-only canary? @Sam Ortiz can you start and watch logs? use `kubectl logs -f` on canary pods and check latency traces.
Sam Ortiz: on it. will post a short summary when canary completes.
deploy-bot: Canary aborted and canary can be retriggered once chart.lock is fixed or image-only flag set. Reaction :warning: :eyes: 
Carlos Vega: small reminder — update release notes with action items: "pinned chart v2.0, postponed payments-subchart v2.1 migration, scheduled full rollout for change window".
Jen Huang: done. release-notes draft: "Hotpatch: image bump only to address urgent perf fix. Chart migration deferred due to dependency lock mismatch. Full rollout planned in change window; migration plan under ARCH-721."
Priya Nair: I'll ping security for a quick re-review of the migration plan tomorrow.
Sam Ortiz: canary finished: 3/3 canary pods healthy, no error-rate increase, tail latency steady. promoting image-only to staging.
Mira Patel: thanks. leaving chart migration + values merge to change window after ARCH-721 signoff. Closing thread; ENG-3098 will track next steps.
ops-bot: ENG-3098 updated with canary result by Sam Ortiz.
